name: Seven
source:
Seven is a suspenseful visual novel about a man who awakens in limbo. He has lost his memories and in order to regain them, he must face the seven deadly sins. A choose your own adventure game that's psychologically thrilling.

[From [url=http://contest.rpgmakerweb.com/game/view/id/327#.U8RmaJRdVeH]2014 Indie Game Maker Contest page[/url]]
translation:
《七号》是一部悬疑视觉小说，讲述了一个在地狱边缘醒来的男人的故事。他失去了记忆，为了恢复记忆，他必须面对七大罪。一款选择你自己的冒险游戏，在心理上令人兴奋。

[来自[url=http://contest.rpgmakerweb.com/game/view/id/327#.U8RmaJRdVeH]2014独立游戏制作大赛页面[/url]]
